breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet (u=0) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly implemented this fix by only mentioning the 'Dirichlet boundary condition u = 0 on all four edges' and omitting the incorrect periodic condition.
